senses.gloss:
दिह् दिह्, ii. 2, Par., Ātm. To smear.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. दिग्ध,
 1. Smeared, Man. 3, 132.
 2. Anointed, Rām. 3, 42, 39. m. A poisoned arrow, Man. 7, 90; Rām. 2, 114, 33 Gorr.
 --With the prep. आ आ, आदिग्ध,
 1. Smeared, MBh. 6, 4384.
 2. Anointed, 7, 4386.
 --With उप उप, उपदिग्ध, Overlaid, Suśr. 2, 376, 11.
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To smear, Bhag. 2, 5.
 2. To anoint, Suśr. 1, 42, 19.
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To smear, MBh. 8, 3161.
 2. To cover, Vikr. d. 43. Pass. To be dubious, Rām. 5, 18, 17. संदिग्ध,
 1. Poisoned (?), Daśak. in Chr. 197, 2.
 2. Indistinct, MBh. 1, 6565.
 3. Dubious, uncertain, Pañc. i. d. 196.
 4. Desponding, Rām. 1, 66, 25. अ-संदिग्ध + म्, adv. Undoubtedly, Pañc. 241, 8. निस्-संदिग्ध, adj. Certain, MBh. 13, 3528. ˚धम्, adv. Undoubtedly, MBh. 12, 7809.
 --Cf. τείχος, τοῖχος; Lat. tingere; θιγγάνω; Lat. fingo, figulus; O.H.G. ziagal; A.S. tigel, tigul; Goth. deigaṇ, ga-dikis, daigs; A.S. díc, deag.
